items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: I was playing with Eve Ann Thomas. Black Eagle Band.

ctx.x: Well, I'd come back and... Just by the time I knew they were gonna close up, see. Well, I know the man ain't made no money. You know, I'm working regular. Yeah, man. Paying this much I made for the whole side. You know, the nice side. Mm-hmm. Well, that's how we used to get along. I had a little fella named George Washington. Nice trombone player. I sent him in here for a moment. Laughhead, do's at him. Him and his wife. He was out there with more rain in. They wasn't doing nothing. Wasn't makin' no money. I…
